Innerly

Privacy Policy

Rituraj Singh Ratan operates Innerly, a website for personal reflection. You can complete a check-in and view your report without an account.

Check-ins and reports

Innerly calculates your report in your browser. Unfinished answers stay in the open page until you choose to save a draft; a saved draft then saves subsequent edits as you go. Completed reports and their answers save automatically in that browser and can be reopened from My reports. New reports do not automatically remove older ones. If browser storage is unavailable or full, the page explains that the report has not been saved. Innerly does not upload check-in answers, scores or reports to its servers, Clerk or Google. Signing in does not sync them across devices.

Anyone with access to the same browser profile may be able to open saved reports. You can delete individual reports from My reports, discard an unfinished check-in, or clear the site’s data in your browser. Signing out leaves those local saves in place. Innerly also stores preferences such as your chosen language and may temporarily store where to return after sign-in.

Feedback

The feedback form currently saves your name, email address, message and selected feedback type in this browser only. It does not send them to the Innerly team or an email service. These notes remain on this device until the browser removes the site's data. Other people using the same browser profile may be able to access them. Please leave health details and report answers out of feedback.

Accounts and Google sign-in

Clerk processes your email address and account and session information to create your account, verify sign-ins and keep you signed in. It uses cookies and similar technology to manage authentication. When Google sign-in is available and you choose it, Google shares basic identity information with Clerk, such as your Google account identifier, email address, name and profile picture if provided. Innerly uses this information to identify you and provide account access.

Innerly requests only Google’s basic identity permissions. It does not request access to Gmail, Drive, contacts or calendars. Innerly does not sell Google account data or use it for advertising. Its use of information received from Google APIs follows the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

Hosting and other service providers

GitHub Pages hosts Innerly. When you load the site, GitHub and services that deliver resources such as Google Fonts receive technical information such as your IP address and browser request details. Clerk and Google process authentication requests when their services are used. Their handling of technical information is described in the GitHub Privacy Statement, Clerk Privacy Policy and Google Privacy Policy.

Retention and your choices

Saved check-in data remains in your browser until you remove it or the browser clears it. Clerk stores account data so you can continue to sign in. You can contact Innerly to request access to, correction of, or deletion of account information. Depending on where you live, you may have additional privacy rights. You can also revoke Innerly’s access through your Google Account connections. Revoking access does not delete a Clerk account or local reports.

For privacy questions and account requests, email riturajratan@gmail.com. Please leave check-in answers and reports out of your message.
